the ambient sweep direction of the loop-open map is not published; the primary is the up-sweep (from cold), chosen before any comparison. At this power the fixed-code line is hysteretic (bistable) between 66.00 and 68.00 degC (the two branches differ by up to 7.0 K of ring temperature); the 5 degC sampled offsets of both directions nevertheless agree, because no sample falls inside that window. The self-heating steepens the cold side (laser red of the resonance, positive feedback; the up-sweep jumps across it) and widens the hot side.
